title: The most unlikely Bundesliga winners of all - DW News
content: But 22 years ago, they shot up from the second tier to win the Bundesliga at the first go, crushing Bayern Munich on the way. If Otto Rehhagel hoped to carry some of the momentum from his team's march to the 1996-97 Bundesliga 2 title in to a daunting season in Germany's top flight, he was dealt an early blow when the fixture list came out. His revenge was first swift — as an 80th-minute goal from Michael Schjonberg secured the newly-promoted side a shock win on the opening day — then deep, with Kaiserslautern briefly breaking Bayern and Borussia Dortmund's decade-long duopoly with a title win forged on that first day. The side from a town with a population of less than 100,000 in the south-west of Germany drew an average gate of 36,709 to the Fritz Walter stadium in their victorious 2.Bundesliga campaign, with the name of their ground a nod to their rich history —Walter was captain of the West Germany side that pulled off one of the biggest shocks in World Cup history in 1954.

In Bundesliga history, only one has become the sole story of an unspeakable championship victory by a newly promoted team. FC Kaiserslautern in the 1997-98 season. Among all of Bundesliga history, Kaiserslautern stands alone as the only team to have won the championship right after promotion and become a permanent member of the football legend. content: # Kaiserslautern: The Only Team to Win the Bundesliga Right After Promotion. Kaiserslautern: The Only Team to Win the Bundesliga Right After Promotion. In 1998, newly-promoted Kaiserslautern achieved the impossible: winning the Bundesliga in their first season back in the top flight. In 1998, newly-promoted Kaiserslautern achieved the impossible: winning the Bundesliga in their first season back in the top flight. In 1996-97, Kaiserslautern dominated the second division, winning promotion at the first attempt with a squad that was largely unchanged from the team that had been relegated. Kaiserslautern had done what no promoted team had ever done before – they had won the Bundesliga in their first season back. Today, promoted teams face opponents with vastly superior resources, making it almost impossible to sustain a title challenge over an entire season. The same is true in other major leagues – promoted teams occasionally surprise with good seasons, but winning the league immediately? Kaiserslautern didn't just win the Bundesliga – they made history.

title: How promoted Kaiserslautern won the Bundesliga | UEFA.com
content: How promoted Kaiserslautern won the Bundesliga. With promoted ASA Trgu Mureş closing on the Romanian title, UEFA.com's Steffen Potter recalls how Otto Rehhagel's 1. Otto Rehhagel lifts the Bundesliga trophy after promoted Kaiserslautern's 1997/98 success ©Getty Images. Otto Rehhagel lifts the Bundesliga trophy after promoted Kaiserslautern's 1997/98 success. FC Kaiserslautern, founder members of the Bundesliga, were relegated in 1996 the fans' devastation was all-consuming. A year before they had finished fourth and qualified for the UEFA Cup, and they were through to the German Cup final – a week after their fate was sealed, they duly lifted it for only the second time. Firstly, Otto Rehhagel was deemed surplus to requirements at Bayern; their loss was Kaiserslautern's gain. In essence, the team remained a top-tier side in the second division, winning at a canter and retaining a large fan base: their average attendance of 36,709 was higher than in the previous Bundesliga campaign.
